sites.functional_impact_measured: Cell-surface biotinylation and western blot confirmed CD320-FLAG on the cell surface of HEK293 and HepG2 cells. Vitamin B12 uptake function of the tagged construct was not measured in isolation.
sites.rationale: CD320 shares the LDLR-like repeat architecture with LDLR. An N-terminal FLAG tag after the signal peptide was confirmed on the cell surface by biotinylation, providing indirect support for the same approach in LDLR. A GS linker between the tag and A22 is recommended to avoid steric clash with the first disulfide-bonded LDL-binding repeat beginning at C27.
